messages:
maria: Heads up — reports from customer X that the Insights dashboard is showing rows from other orgs when they switch projects fast. Repro on prod for at least 2 users. Screenshot attached: https://img.redwood.internal/snap/abc123 :eyes:
alex: ugh. Can you paste repro steps? is this the widget preview or full dashboard view?
maría: quick steps: login -> select org A -> open Insights -> rapidly switch to org B (top-right org switcher) -> click panel preview. Sometimes the panel still shows org A rows. Happens with canned time range and saved filter.
jo: I think you meant maria :)
noah: suspecting prefetch/cache layer. Prefetch service normalizes headers for affinitized routes, we recently changed header key from `X-Org-ID` -> `x-tenant-id` in rollout v2 (case normalization + rename). If old clients send X-Org-ID it might bypass new normalization and end up cached under the wrong key.
jess: grabbing logs now. Saw two entries in prefetch logs where cache_key was `prefetch:route:/insights:org:null` around 1748888822. Also found an odd sequence where the affinity cookie is appended after the redirect.
alex: can you paste the exact cache_key snippet? also, is the dashboard rendering using the cached snapshot or doing a live query?
jess: snippet: ```
2026-03-20T18:47:02Z prefetch INFO cache_set key=prefetch:route:/insights:org:null hit=0 ttl=300
2026-03-20T18:47:03Z prefetch WARN header_normalize from=X-Org-ID to=x-tenant-id matched=false
```
sam: If prefetch keys are normalized inconsistently across the edge and the console, you get cross-org snapshots. Worst-case: quick switch + canary traffic routed to new edge + some requests hitting old edge with different header mapping. That's consistent with customer repro.
maria: this coincided with the rollout of route-affinity v2 and the quota header change last night. We rolled the canary to 20% at 17:30 UTC.
noah: quick hypothesis: old edge -> cache store under legacy key, new edge -> normalize to new key and serve that; but the console sometimes fetches snapshot by route only (missing org header) when previewing which causes fallback to last cached route snapshot (org:null). That explains mixed rows.
alex: urgent mitigation: 1) disable prefetch caching for /insights previews (fast) 2) back out header rename in canary (safer) 3) add a hard org-scope on cache keys (longer). Thoughts?
sam: +1 to 1) and 3). 2) might be disruptive but ok if we see more reports. I'll open rollback playbook if deploy-bot can pause the canary.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Rollout pause requested by @sam for release route-affinity-v2 at 1748888940. Canary traffic frozen at 20%.
jess: disabled prefetch cache for /insights preview in staging, can reproduce locally -> going to patch prod config now (toggle only).
maria: thanks. also let's surface this in Console > Rollouts UX docs — the switcher rapid nav is a known stress-case. We should add a test in the rollout playbook to simulate fast org switching.
offers: sorry typo (meant noah)
noah: created issue ENG-3241 with logs, repro gif, and suggested patch: ensure cache key includes tenant header canonical name and fallback to 401 if missing.
alex: created a quick PR to include org id in cache_key generation: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/6666 — please review.
sam: action items: jess patch prod toggle, alex PR review, noah add unit test for header normalization, maria customer follow-up. Putting a brief oncall note so support can message affected customers. :thumbsup:
maria: pinging customer success with a short note and ETA for rollback/patch.
alex: thanks team. keep the thread updated here and add any telemetry spikes.
_meta: Generated Slack thread: multi-tenant console preview leakage; discusses prefetch cache keys, header rename, rollout canary, mitigation and actions
